pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 15-unit grammatikasini takrorlaydi: ko'chirma buyruqlar, undov gaplar, ajratilgan savollar (question tags).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 15-UNIT NAZARIYA (72-bet, PDF 71). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '15', sarlavha 'Reported Instructions/Commands - Exclamations - Question Tags'. Butun bet jigarrang ramkali nazariya qutisi.

CHAP USTUN:
'Reported Instructions/Commands': To report instructions or commands we use the verbs ask, tell or order + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive. Direct speech: "Be polite with the customers," he said. Reported speech: He told me to be polite with the customers. Direct speech: "Don't talk so much, please," he said to me. Reported speech: He asked me not to talk so much.
'Exclamations': Exclamations are words or sentences used to express admiration, surprise etc. To form exclamatory sentences we can use what (a/an), how etc. • What + a/an (+ adjective) + singular countable noun: What a beautiful day! What an experience! • What (+ adjective) + uncountable/plural nouns: What interesting news! What terrible mistakes! • how + adjective/adverb: How pretty she is! How fast he runs!
'Question Tags': Question tags are short questions at the end of statements. We use them in speech when we want to confirm something or when we want to find out if something is true or not. Dogs swim, don't they? Your father is a farmer, isn't he?
'Form': • We form a question tag with the auxiliary or modal verb of the main sentence and the appropriate subject pronoun. Mary is cooking, isn't she? Tom can't play the violin, can he?

O'NG USTUN:
• When the verb of the main sentence is in the present simple, we form the question tag with the auxiliary verb do/does and the subject pronoun. When the verb is in the past simple, we form the question tag with the auxiliary did and the subject pronoun. Carol likes football, doesn't she? He found his book, didn't he? • When the sentence is positive, the question tag is negative. He works for a large computer firm, doesn't he? • When the sentence is negative, the question tag is positive. She didn't do her homework, did she? • Some verbs/expressions form question tags differently. Study the following examples: a) I am → aren't I? I am quick, aren't I? b) Don't → will you? Don't talk, will you? c) Imperative → will/won't you? Stop shouting, will/won't you? d) Let's → shall we? Let's go out for dinner, shall we? e) I have (got) → haven't I? (=I possess) He has got a large house, hasn't he? f) I have → don't I? (other meanings) She has dinner at 6 o'clock, doesn't she? g) There is/are → isn't/aren't there? There is a cushion on the sofa, isn't there? h) This/That is → isn't it? That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it?
'Intonation': • When we are sure of the answer and expect agreement, the voice goes down in the question tag. She's your daughter, isn't she? (↘) • When we aren't sure of the answer and we want to check information, the voice goes up in the question tag. He can't drive a car, can he? (↗)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '72'.

exercises.instructionEn: To report instructions or commands we use the verbs ask, tell or order + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive. Direct speech: 'Be polite with the customers,' he said. → Reported speech: He told me to be polite with the customers. Direct speech: 'Don't talk so much, please,' he said to me. → Reported speech: He asked me not to talk so much.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatma yoki buyruqlarni ko'chirish uchun ask, tell yoki order + to'ldiruvchi + (not) + to-infinitiv ishlatiladi. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri: 'Mijozlar bilan xushmuomala bo'l,' dedi u. → Ko'chirma: U menga mijozlar bilan xushmuomala bo'lishni aytdi. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri: 'Iltimos, ko'p gapirma,' dedi u menga. → Ko'chirma: U mendan ko'p gapirmaslikni so'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ / KO'RSATMA.

  QOLIP:
    ask / tell / order + KIMGA +
    (not) + TO + FE'L

  TASDIQ BUYRUQ:
    "Be polite with the customers,"
    he said.
    → He TOLD me TO BE polite with
      the customers.

  INKOR BUYRUQ:
    "Don't talk so much, please,"
    he said to me.
    → He ASKED me NOT TO TALK so
      much.

  ⚠ 'Don't' → NOT TO + fe'l
    (didn't ✗, to not ✗).
  ⚠ 'please' bo'lsa → ASKED
    (iltimos), qattiq buyruq →
    ORDERED, oddiy → TOLD.
  ⚠ Zamon o'zgarmaydi - to-infinitiv
    zamonsiz.


⚠ 'POLITE':

  = xushmuomala, odobli.

exercises.instructionUz: Undov gaplar - hayrat, ajablanish va h.k.ni ifodalovchi so'z yoki gaplar. Undov gap tuzish uchun what (a/an), how va boshqalar ishlatiladi. What + a/an (+ sifat) + birlik sanaladigan ot: Qanday go'zal kun! Qanday tajriba! What (+ sifat) + sanalmaydigan/ko'plik ot: Qanday qiziq yangilik! Qanday dahshatli xatolar! how + sifat/ravish: U qanday chiroyli! U qanday tez yuguradi!
exercises.explanationUz:
UNDOV GAPLAR - 3 QOLIP.

  1) WHAT + A/AN (+ sifat) + BIRLIK
     SANALADIGAN OT
     What A beautiful day!
     What AN experience!

  2) WHAT (+ sifat) + SANALMAYDIGAN
     / KO'PLIK OT (a/an YO'Q)
     What interesting news!
     What terrible mistakes!

  3) HOW + SIFAT / RAVISh
     How pretty she is!
     How fast he runs!

  ⚠ 'What' - OT bilan; 'How' -
    SIFAT/RAVISh bilan.
  ⚠ 'news' - sanalmaydi → 'What
    interesting news!' (a ✗).
  ⚠ HOW dan keyin ega + fe'l:
    How pretty SHE IS! (savol
    tartibi emas).


⚠ 'ADMIRATION':

  = hayrat, zavqlanish.

exercises.instructionUz: Ajratilgan savollar - darak gap oxiridagi qisqa savollar. Ular og'zaki nutqda biror narsani tasdiqlash yoki to'g'ri-noto'g'riligini bilish uchun ishlatiladi. Itlar suzadi, shundaymi? Dadangiz fermer, shundaymi? Shakli: ajratilgan savol asosiy gapning yordamchi yoki modal fe'li + mos olmosh bilan tuziladi. Meri ovqat pishiryapti, shundaymi? Tom skripka chala olmaydi, shundaymi? Asosiy gap fe'li present simple bo'lsa, savol do/does + olmosh bilan; past simple bo'lsa did + olmosh bilan tuziladi. Kerol futbolni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U kitobini topdi, shundaymi? Gap tasdiq bo'lsa, savol inkor. U katta kompyuter firmasida ishlaydi, shundaymi? Gap inkor bo'lsa, savol tasdiq. U uy vazifasini qilmadi, shundaymi?
exercises.explanationUz:
QUESTION TAGS - GAP OXIRIDAGI
  QISQA SAVOL ('shundaymi?').

  MAQSAD: tasdiqlash yoki
  tekshirish.
    Dogs swim, DON'T THEY?
    Your father is a farmer, ISN'T
    HE?

  SHAKLI:
  YORDAMChI / MODAL FE'L + OLMOSh
    Mary IS cooking, ISN'T SHE?
    Tom CAN'T play the violin, CAN
    HE?

  PRESENT SIMPLE → do/does:
    Carol LIKES football, DOESN'T
    SHE?
  PAST SIMPLE → did:
    He FOUND his book, DIDN'T HE?

  QOIDA: TESKARISI!
  TASDIQ gap → INKOR savol:
    He works for a large computer
    firm, DOESN'T he?
  INKOR gap → TASDIQ savol:
    She didn't do her homework,
    DID she?

  ⚠ Olmosh ishlatiladi: 'Carol ...,
    doesn't SHE?' (doesn't Carol ✗).


⚠ 'A COMPUTER FIRM':

  = kompyuter firmasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Some verbs/expressions form question tags differently. Study the following examples: a) I am → aren't I? I am quick, aren't I? b) Don't → will you? Don't talk, will you? c) Imperative → will/won't you? Stop shouting, will/won't you? d) Let's → shall we? Let's go out for dinner, shall we? e) I have (got) → haven't I? (= I possess) He has got a large house, hasn't he? f) I have → don't I? (other meanings) She has dinner at 6 o'clock, doesn't she? g) There is/are → isn't/aren't there? There is a cushion on the sofa, isn't there? h) This/That is → isn't it? That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it? Intonation: When we are sure of the answer and expect agreement, the voice goes down in the question tag. She's your daughter, isn't she? (↘) When we aren't sure of the answer and we want to check information, the voice goes up in the question tag. He can't drive a car, can he? (↗)
exercises.instructionUz: Ba'zi fe'l/iboralar ajratilgan savolni boshqacha tuzadi. Misollarni o'rganing: a) I am → aren't I? Men tezman, shundaymi? b) Don't → will you? Gapirma, xo'pmi? c) Buyruq → will/won't you? Baqirishni bas qil, xo'pmi? d) Let's → shall we? Kechki ovqatga chiqaylik, a? e) I have (got) → haven't I? (= egalik) Uning katta uyi bor, shundaymi? f) I have → don't I? (boshqa ma'nolar) U soat 6 da kechki ovqat yeydi, shundaymi? g) There is/are → isn't/aren't there? Divanda yostiq bor, shundaymi? h) This/That is → isn't it? Bu Bobning velosipedi, shundaymi? Intonatsiya: javobga ishonganimizda va rozilik kutganimizda ovoz savolda pasayadi. U sizning qizingiz, shundaymi? (↘) Javobga ishonmasak va ma'lumotni tekshirmoqchi bo'lsak, ovoz savolda ko'tariladi. U mashina hayday olmaydi, shundaymi? (↗)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAXSUS HOLATLAR - YOD OLING!

  a) I AM → AREN'T I?
     I am quick, aren't I?
     (amn't ✗)
  b) DON'T ... → WILL YOU?
     Don't talk, will you?
  c) BUYRUQ → WILL / WON'T YOU?
     Stop shouting, will/won't you?
  d) LET'S → SHALL WE?
     Let's go out for dinner, shall
     we?
  e) HAVE (GOT) = egalik →
     HAVEN'T I?
     He has got a large house,
     hasn't he?
  f) HAVE = boshqa ma'no (yemoq,
     qilmoq) → DON'T I?
     She has dinner at 6 o'clock,
     doesn't she?
  g) THERE IS/ARE → ISN'T/AREN'T
     THERE?
     There is a cushion on the sofa,
     isn't there?
  h) THIS/THAT IS → ISN'T IT?
     That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it?


INTONATSIYA:

  ↘ PASAYADI - javobga ISHONAMIZ,
    rozilik kutamiz:
    She's your daughter, isn't
    she? ↘

  ↗ KO'TARILADI - ISHONMAYMIZ,
    tekshiramiz:
    He can't drive a car, can he? ↗


⚠ 'A CUSHION':

  = divan yostig'i.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Ko'chirma buyruq, undov gap, ajratilgan savol.

patterns.formula: KIM + told / asked / ordered + KIMGA + (not) + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: He told me to be polite with the customers. He asked me not to talk so much.
patterns.exampleUz: U menga mijozlar bilan xushmuomala bo'lishni aytdi. U mendan ko'p gapirmaslikni so'radi.

patterns.formula: What + a/an + SIFAT + OT! / How + SIFAT + EGA + FE'L!
patterns.exampleEn: What a beautiful day! How pretty she is!
patterns.exampleUz: Qanday go'zal kun! U qanday chiroyli!
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ What - ot bilan, How - sifat bilan.

patterns.formula: TASDIQ GAP, + INKOR YORDAMChI + OLMOSh? / INKOR GAP, + TASDIQ YORDAMChI + OLMOSh?
patterns.exampleEn: Carol likes football, doesn't she? She didn't do her homework, did she?
patterns.exampleUz: Kerol futbolni yoqtiradi, shundaymi? U uy vazifasini qilmadi, shundaymi?

patterns.formula: Let's + FE'L, shall we? / BUYRUQ, will you?
patterns.exampleEn: Let's go out for dinner, shall we? Don't talk, will you?
patterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqatga chiqaylik, a? Gapirma, xo'pmi?
